authority: provider-fact research only; does not approve an AIPS SKU, AIPS price, access model, payment method, delivery SLA, warranty, customer metric, or resale arrangement
publication_rule: Provider facts may inform customer education only after route-specific review. AIPS commercial facts remain fail-closed unless separately approved in canonical SSOT.

verified_facts: Plus is an individual subscription with enhanced ChatGPT access and higher usage limits.
Current official benefits include advanced reasoning access, voice, image generation, file analysis, deep research where available, and custom GPT creation/use.
OpenAI states an individual account is for the person who created it and account sharing is not allowed.
records.customer_problem: A customer needs one general-purpose AI workspace for writing, research, analysis, files, coding support, images and voice without switching tools for every task.
records.solution_summary: Position Plus around individual productivity and multimodal work on the customer's own account, not shared credentials.
limitations: usage limits can vary
API billing is separate
individual account credentials must not be shared
existing_content_risks: Current products.json contains ChatGPT shared-access variants and seat pools that conflict with OpenAI's account-sharing policy.
Current copy contains fixed AIPS delivery/warranty/commercial claims that require separate AIPS evidence.
Model/feature names must be generated from a fresh official fact layer rather than frozen copy.
records.recommended_public_action: Keep provider education current; quarantine shared-login commercial variants unless an explicitly provider-authorized model exists.

verified_facts: Pro targets everyday productivity and provides more usage than Free.
Official current plan material includes Claude Code, Projects, Research, extended thinking and additional model access.
records.customer_problem: A customer needs strong long-form reasoning, writing, research and coding assistance with more capacity than a free tier.
records.solution_summary: Explain Claude Pro as a productivity/reasoning subscription and compare it by workflow, not unsupported superlatives.
limitations: usage capacity is not unlimited
regional price/tax handling varies
records.recommended_public_action: Refresh feature copy from Anthropic source and keep access/account model customer-owned unless separately authorized.

verified_facts: Pro is designed for advanced search/research workflows.
Official materials emphasize cited answers, Pro Search, file analysis/uploads, image generation, Spaces and advanced model access/higher limits.
records.customer_problem: A customer wants faster web research with citations and the ability to investigate documents without manually opening many sources.
records.solution_summary: Lead with cited research, source checking and file analysis instead of calling it a generic chatbot replacement.
limitations: AI answers can still be inaccurate and sources should be checked
feature/usage limits vary by plan
records.recommended_public_action: Build problem-led research pages around source-backed discovery and verification workflows.

verified_facts: Google AI Pro includes 5 TB storage and expanded Gemini usage.
Official current material highlights Gemini in Google apps, Deep Research/file upload capabilities, creative generation and developer benefits, with some features/regions varying.
records.customer_problem: A customer already works in Gmail, Docs, Drive and Google services and wants AI embedded into that ecosystem.
records.solution_summary: Explain ecosystem value, storage and workflow integration rather than using a stale 'Gemini Advanced' feature list.
limitations: feature availability varies by country, language and age
price should be read from the customer's regional checkout when not reliably exposed in public page data
records.recommended_public_action: Do not publish a universal provider price unless the regional/current checkout is evidenced.

verified_facts: Four current subscription tiers are Basic, Standard, Pro and Mega.
Standard/Pro/Mega include Relax Mode for unlimited image generations; Pro/Mega add Stealth Mode and broader relaxed video use.
records.customer_problem: A visual creator needs high-quality concept art, marketing visuals or creative ideation with a predictable generation workflow.
records.solution_summary: Help customers choose by generation volume, privacy/Stealth requirement and workflow intensity.
limitations: plan features and availability can change
company revenue can affect required plan under Midjourney terms
records.recommended_public_action: Avoid estimated shared-plan economics; publish only provider-compliant access arrangements.

verified_facts: Runway is a credit-based image/video/audio creation platform.
Current plans include Free, Standard, Pro, Max and Enterprise; Max is replacing Unlimited for high-generation creators.
records.customer_problem: A creator or agency needs controllable AI video generation plus image/audio tooling without assembling multiple editing pipelines.
records.solution_summary: Explain the credit cost of actual generation workloads and choose a plan based on expected seconds/images, not just tier names.
limitations: credits differ by model, duration and resolution
Standard/Pro monthly credits do not roll over
records.recommended_public_action: Add a Bangladesh-friendly 'how many videos can this plan realistically produce?' explainer using provider credit math.

verified_facts: HeyGen focuses on AI video, digital twins/avatars, voice and translation workflows.
Current public pricing uses credits across paid features and differentiates Creator, Pro and Business plans.
records.customer_problem: A business or creator needs presenter/marketing/localized videos without cameras, actors or repeated studio production.
records.solution_summary: Sell the workflow outcome: script-to-avatar video, translation/localization and reusable brand presenter assets.
limitations: credit use depends on feature
plan details have changed recently, so refresh before publication
records.recommended_public_action: Replace static feature-count claims with checked-date plan facts and outcome-based examples.

verified_facts: Current platform covers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, sound effects, voice design, music, dubbing and related creative/API workflows.
Plan credits and included capabilities differ materially by tier.
records.customer_problem: A customer needs natural voiceovers, dubbing, cloned voices or speech APIs without recording every line manually.
records.solution_summary: Map the plan to minutes/characters, commercial licensing and voice-cloning needs.
limitations: credit economics vary by model/product
taxes excluded from listed provider prices
records.recommended_public_action: Create usage calculators/examples and keep commercial-license wording exactly aligned to provider terms.

verified_facts: Free, Pro and Premier are the current plan types shown publicly.
Paid plans include commercial-use rights for newly created songs made while subscribed, subject to Suno terms; free-plan creations are not automatically granted those rights.
records.customer_problem: A creator wants to produce original music concepts, vocals or background tracks quickly without a traditional production setup.
records.solution_summary: Explain generation credits plus the commercial-rights timing because that is a real buying decision, not a footnote.
limitations: commercial-use rights are not the same as guaranteed copyright protection
paid credits reset monthly
records.recommended_public_action: Add a clear rights/monetization explainer and do not imply retroactive rights for free creations.

verified_facts: Current Copilot plans include Free, Student, Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise.
Paid individual plans include unlimited code completion/next-edit suggestions while AI-credit allowances govern many agent/chat features.
records.customer_problem: A developer wants less boilerplate, faster debugging/review and agent-assisted coding across the IDE, terminal and GitHub workflow.
records.solution_summary: Choose by coding-agent intensity and team governance needs, not only autocomplete.
limitations: agent/model usage consumes AI credits
organizational governance differs from individual plans
records.recommended_public_action: Refresh any old premium-request language to the current AI-credit model.

verified_facts: Cursor offers Hobby plus paid individual and team plans.
Current paid positioning centers on extended Agent usage, frontier models, MCP/skills/hooks, cloud agents and team controls.
records.customer_problem: A developer wants an AI-native editor that can understand and change a codebase rather than only autocomplete lines.
records.solution_summary: Explain Cursor around agentic codebase work, model usage and team privacy/governance.
limitations: model choice affects included usage consumption
usage terms can evolve
records.recommended_public_action: Use a workflow comparison against Copilot/Replit/v0 instead of generic 'best coding AI' claims.

verified_facts: Current Replit plans include Starter, Core, Pro and Enterprise.
Core and Pro include monthly usage credits and autonomous/agentic app-building capabilities; Pro adds higher credits/collaboration and professional support.
records.customer_problem: A non-specialist or developer wants to build, run and publish an application in one environment without managing a local toolchain and deployment stack separately.
records.solution_summary: Explain the end-to-end build-and-deploy workflow and usage-credit economics.
limitations: agent behavior is probabilistic
additional usage can be pay-as-you-go
records.recommended_public_action: Build guides around 'idea to deployed app' and when Core versus Pro economics make sense.

verified_facts: v0 offers a free credit tier plus Team, Business and Enterprise plans.
Current product can build full-stack apps, sync with GitHub and deploy to Vercel, with model/credit usage as part of pricing.
records.customer_problem: A product/design/development user wants to turn UI or product requirements into working web application code rapidly.
records.solution_summary: Frame v0 around prototype-to-production UI/app workflows and Vercel/GitHub integration.
limitations: usage is credit/token based
generated applications still require QA/security/review
records.recommended_public_action: Create a decision guide for v0 vs Replit vs Cursor based on the customer's starting point and deployment needs.

verified_facts: Current Writesonic positioning is AI search visibility/GEO plus SEO/content workflows, not only an AI writer.
Plans combine AI-platform visibility tracking, content/SEO audits and agentic workflows.
records.customer_problem: A brand needs to understand and improve how it appears in Google and AI answer engines while maintaining an SEO/content program.
records.solution_summary: Update old 'AI writer' copy to current GEO/AI-search visibility and SEO use cases.
limitations: plan capabilities and tracked platforms differ by tier
results are not a ranking guarantee
records.recommended_public_action: Rewrite product page around AI visibility + SEO workflow and explicitly avoid guaranteed ranking language.

verified_facts: Notion Business is priced per member and includes Notion AI capabilities such as Agent, AI Meeting Notes and Enterprise Search features.
Guests are distinct from members; team/workspace billing should not be described as a generic transferable subscription.
records.customer_problem: A team needs docs, knowledge, projects, meetings and AI assistance in one governed workspace.
records.solution_summary: Explain seat/member economics, workspace ownership and AI workflow value clearly.
limitations: billing is workspace/member based
some features are beta or use additional Notion credits
records.recommended_public_action: Remove any stale fixed AIPS Notion price/discount claim until exact seat/workspace procurement and margin are approved.

verified_facts: Current individual plans include Free, Plus, Pro and Ultra; Gamma also supports team/business plans.
Gamma creates presentations, docs, sites/social content and supports PPT/PDF import/export; higher tiers increase slide-per-prompt limits and advanced model/customization access.
records.customer_problem: A customer needs to turn rough notes or a brief into a polished presentation/document/site quickly without manually designing every slide.
records.solution_summary: Lead with time-to-first-draft, brand control and export workflow, not only 'AI presentation'.
limitations: public pricing values were not reliably exposed in this verification pass
advanced AI usage may depend on credits/fair-use
records.recommended_public_action: Verify checkout-visible current price before publishing provider-price comparisons.

verified_facts: CapCut explicitly states Pro pricing varies by region, device/platform and promotions.
The provider advises users to check the logged-in upgrade/checkout surface for the current price; the new membership structure includes updated Pro/Standard positioning.
records.customer_problem: A creator wants fast social/video editing, templates and AI-assisted production without a traditional desktop editing learning curve.
records.solution_summary: Explain CapCut by creator workflow and make price inquiry/checkout verification explicit instead of hard-coding one global official price.
limitations: no single universal provider price
plan availability and promotions can differ by account/platform/region
records.recommended_public_action: Remove stale universal official-price claims; display 'provider price varies—check current checkout' until exact regional evidence is attached.

verified_facts: The Basic plan is legacy and no longer available for new purchase.
Current plans use priority/slow credits and paid tiers add private generation, image upload/editing and higher concurrency.
records.customer_problem: A designer/marketer needs controllable AI image generation, especially text-in-image/creative asset production and private workflows.
records.solution_summary: Explain generation-credit volume, private generation and design workflow differences by tier.
limitations: legacy Basic must not be marketed as currently purchasable
credit costs vary by model/rendering
records.recommended_public_action: Audit any Basic-plan or old-credit references and replace them with current plan structure.

verified_facts: Manus currently documents Free, Pro and Team plan families.
Pro is credit-based and includes higher-capability Agent modes, research, website deployment, slides and multiple concurrent/scheduled tasks depending on tier.
records.customer_problem: A user needs an agent to execute multi-step research and creation tasks rather than only answer individual prompts.
records.solution_summary: Position around delegated multi-step work and credit economics, with clear boundaries on what the agent can reliably complete.
limitations: credit use depends on task complexity
plan details can change rapidly
records.recommended_public_action: Use checked-date plan descriptions and avoid treating older model/version labels as evergreen facts.
